Note that `__Pausable_init()` is a no-op in OpenZeppelin v5 — the pause flag lives in ERC-7201 namespaced storage and already defaults to `false`, so the router is fully functional without this call. It is invoked here to keep the pause module's activation explicit for already-deployed proxies and to make the role grants part of the same transaction. Pass `address(0)` for either role to skip granting it.

IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.
